      38 +  if (POINTER_TRUST.test(tail)) return 'trust'
      39 +  if (!POINTER_NUM.test(tail)) return null
      40
      39 -  // Below here a numbered option must be present: no picker, no question.
      40 -  if (!pointer) return null
      41 -
      42 -  // Plan approval (ExitPlanMode).
      43 -  if (/Would you like to proceed\?|No, keep planning|written up a plan|Here is Claude's plan|Ready to code\?/.test(text))
      44 -    return 'plan'
      45 -
      46 -  // Tool-permission prompt.
      41 +  // On a numbered picker: classify by the phrasing above the option. The folder
      42 +  // trust check also shows a number once you arrow onto "Yes, I trust…".
      43 +  const text = lines.join('\n')
      44 +  if (/Quick safety check|Do you trust the files in this folder/.test(text)) return 'trust'
      45 +  if (/Would you like to proceed\?|No, keep planning|written up a plan|Here is Claude's plan|Ready to code\?/.test(text)) return 'plan'
      46    if (/Do you want to proceed\?/.test(text)) return 'permission'
      48 -
      49 -  // Everything else that sits on a numbered picker: AskUserQuestion (which also
      50 -  // shows a ☐ header), and any other agent prompt — a Codex approval included,
      47 +  // AskUserQuestion, and any other agent prompt — a Codex approval included —
      48    // so the tab still flags even for a shape we have not catalogued.
      49    return 'question'
      50  }
